title: hermes.config.json schema
description: Configuration for PlayGround Hermes bytecode toolchain.

engineVersion.description: Hermes engine version the bytecode is built for (bytecode is version-coupled; rebuild on upgrade).

bytecodeTarget.description: Expected Hermes bytecode version (e.g. 96 for Hermes 0.12.0). Verified against the .hbc header.

entry.description: Hermes-safe entry file (DOM-free), bundled into the HBC.

coreDir.description: Directory of DOM-free Hermes-safe core game files.

browserEntry.description: DOM adapter entry. Excluded from HBC bundle.

bundle.description: Concatenated JS bundle path (input to hermes -emit-binary).

fallbackManifest.description: Fallback manifest path written when no hermes binary is available.

level.description: strict forbids Node-isms and dynamic import in core.
